items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Fats sounded beautiful, I thought, with Tadd Dameron.

ctx.x: Yeah, the big band. Yeah, Dizzy was poppin' them, too, but I mean, he always turned it around with something. But we'd go heckle him just for the hell of it, just to egg him on. 'All right, play something, motherfucker,' you know. Not that we hated him or anything. We were just egging him on, to make him play something. That's what we were doing with him then.
